meta.name: value-ladder-architect
meta.description: Design the complete free-to-premium value ladder for affiliate promotions. Triggers on: "value ladder", "customer journey", "upsell path", "ascension model", "free to paid funnel", "tripwire offer", "upsell strategy", "downsell", "product ladder", "price ladder", "customer ascension", "funnel architecture", "map my funnel", "design my funnel stages", "monetization path".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计免费到付费的完整价值阶梯，提升联盟营销转化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在推广产品时想设计诱人的升级路径
copy.tagline_en: Design a complete free-to-premium value ladder to boost affiliate conversions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create compelling upsell paths for your promotions

howto.what: CLAUDE会根据你提供的产品信息和你的现有资源（如博客、邮件列表），设计一个完整的免费→低价诱饵→核心产品→升级产品的价值阶梯。它会输出每一阶梯的具体内容、价格、页面类型和转化到下一阶梯的方法。
howto.when: 当你提到“价值阶梯”、“客户旅程”、“升单路径”等关键词，或者要求设计漏斗阶段、优化联盟推广时触发。也可在已设计了核心产品后，想扩展为完整阶梯时使用。

say.text: 帮我设计HeyGen的价值阶梯，我有博客和邮件列表。
为Semrush推广设计免费到付费的漏斗，目标是最佳LTV。
基于我已有的赠品堆栈，映射我的推广漏斗。
say.note: 它会利用之前的赠品作为诱饵，设计整体阶梯。

howto.what_en: Claude designs a complete free-to-premium value ladder for affiliate promotions, including free content, tripwire, core product, and upsell. It maps each rung's offer, page type, and conversion mechanism to the next level.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'value ladder', 'customer journey', 'upsell path', or ask for funnel design. Also after designing a core offer with grand-slam-offer.

say_en.text: Design a value ladder for HeyGen, I have a blog and email list.
Map my Semrush funnel from free to paid, maximize LTV.
say_en.note: You'll get a roadmap with blog, tripwire, core, and upsell stages.

say_en.text: Build a ladder using my existing bonus stack.
say_en.note: It uses your bonuses as tripwire and designs the full ascension path.
